rationale: The plan correctly uses DESeq2 with ~condition, apeglm shrinkage, padj<0.05, keeps sample_01 with a sensitivity run, and explicitly refuses to treat the >60% duplication as a reason to remove reads or samples, which matches the reference. It falls short of the reference on QC: it never quantifies the rRNA, mitochondrial, or intronic fractions that explain the duplication in rRNA-depleted total RNA, nor does it consider removing rRNA/mt genes if their share is large and uneven; sample distances are also absent. No explicit minimal low-count filter is stated (only default independent filtering), the reference level is not set, and the |LFC|>=1 list is a post hoc cutoff rather than an lfcThreshold test. Enrichment was not requested; it is included with named collections and versions but no ORA universe or set-size window, and package versions are not reported.
